reels.title: Stop ripening mangoes in the fridge

hooks.say: Your fridge is ruining your mangoes.
hooks.show: A hand pulls a hard green mango out of the fridge

hooks.say: Cold mangoes never ripen. Here is why.
hooks.show: Close-up of a cut mango with a pale centre

hooks.say: Stop putting raw mangoes in the fridge.
hooks.show: A mango box being opened on a kitchen counter

beats.say: Cold stops the ripening. The mango stays hard outside and sour inside, so it feels like a bad box.
beats.text: Ripening mangoes? Not in the cold
beats.show: Side by side: a fridge mango and a counter mango

beats.say: Keep them in the box at room temperature, wrapped in paper. Press the top gently each morning.
beats.show: Mangoes wrapped in newspaper inside the box

beats.say: When it gives a little and smells sweet at the stem, then it goes in the fridge.
beats.show: A thumb presses the mango, then the nose at the stem

cta.say: Save this for your next box.
cta.show: A ripe mango sliced on a plate

reels.caption:
Ripening mangoes in the fridge keeps them sour.
Keep them in the box at room temperature until they smell sweet at the stem, then chill.

Save this for your next box.

reels.title: How to tell a naturally ripened mango

angle.text: how do I know a mango is naturally ripened

hooks.show: Two mangoes on a table, one bright yellow, one patchy

hooks.say: Natural or carbide? Check the colour first.
hooks.show: A finger points at green patches on a mango

hooks.say: That perfect yellow mango is a warning.
hooks.show: A shiny, evenly yellow mango turning in a hand

beats.say: Carbide colours the skin fast but leaves the inside raw, which is why some boxes look ripe and taste sour.
beats.show: A bright mango cut open with a white centre

beats.say: A natural mango has patches of green and yellow, smells sweet at the stem, and is soft all over.
beats.text: Naturally ripened mango: patches, smell, soft
beats.show: Three quick shots: the patches, the stem, a gentle press

cta.say: Send this to the friend who buys mangoes every Sunday.
cta.show: Two people sharing a mango slice

reels.caption:
How to tell a naturally ripened mango from a carbide one: patchy colour, a sweet smell at the stem, soft all over.

Send this to the friend who buys the mangoes.
